g.text: A–C: median and interquartile band across 8 slots; bands show sample spread, not confidence intervals.

g.text: Goal hold: 0/64 episodes in both diagnostic cohorts. Entering SETTLE does not establish stable goal hold.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #414141

g.text: Hold requires speed < 0.10 m/s and angular speed < 0.10 rad/s for 0.5 s, with current goal distance < 0.10 m.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #414141

g.text: First 8 episodes per group; 0.1 s samples; all slots active throughout. Cohorts are not strictly paired.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #414141

g.text: Mechanism visualization only; not a formal success-rate estimate. Offline known-box geometry; original perturbations retained.
